summary: replay of a sent picture: attachment note stripped from stored prompt and picture drawn again; any picture in a bubble or the composer opens an in-app viewer (x, backdrop, Escape) instead of Windows Photos; reasoning box follows its newest line while staying collapsible

git.head: d72e3678dbff4737358b3063cddcf1cf2459dea0
git.subject: internal: ปิดท้ายบันทึกผลการปล่อย v0.5.15

summary: DeepSeek provider (first-party, paid, thinking on); streaming answer now holds the bottom instead of a single scroll so late layout cannot unpin the reader; queued-message editor got the missing media stylesheet; saved-chat dates are d/m/y with a Buddhist year in Thai; light theme as a token re-point with dark as default and a toggle under Settings

git.head: d72e3678dbff4737358b3063cddcf1cf2459dea0

summary: fixed a window that opened with nothing usable: a stray closing div closed the sidebar early and pushed the composer off screen; the theme boot script also read the wrong bridge name so a saved theme was ignored; added a markup-nesting selftest and a live check that the shell is usable and the theme switches

git.head: d72e3678dbff4737358b3063cddcf1cf2459dea0
git.subject: internal: ปิดท้ายบันทึกผลการปล่อย v0.5.15

summary: light mode made some text invisible: every text colour that was a literal (#fff on bold text, buttons, the selected settings tab, the find highlight, and pale tool-chip/shell/guide greys) is now a palette token with separate fill tokens for white-on-accent; the live shell check measures real light-mode contrast and fails at 1:1 if a literal comes back

git.head: d72e3678dbff4737358b3063cddcf1cf2459dea0
git.subject: internal: ปิดท้ายบันทึกผลการปล่อย v0.5.15

summary: the yellow notice bar never hid because most callers passed no duration: it now defaults to five seconds, shows a live countdown, and pauses while hovered, focused or while its text is selected; the theme now travels to the window as an argument instead of a synchronous IPC that hung every harness loading the page without a main process
